entries.body: Polished visuals, same village: damage cracks and embers on hurt buildings, level flair on veterans, pond glints, distant birds, longer dawn shadows, drifting cloud shade, disciplined battle shake, and a Quality setting (Low/Med/High) with auto-degrade for older phones.
entries.title: Visual polish pass

entries.body: Act XI opens beyond the Grey Dawn: a harder scorched-ridge finale against the Ashen Warlord, with a soul-choir celebration song that settles quiet after five minutes. Clear it to crown the campaign.
entries.title: The Ashen Crown — Act XI opens

entries.body: Rangers come home loaded now: rescued villagers join the roster, salvaged tablets feed research, recovered relics bless the whole village, and treeline word about the enemy buys extra warning before the next raid. Night and fog make the trail riskier — scouts find the most.
entries.title: Expeditions bring it home

entries.body: Patch notes now live inside the game — this board. Open it any time from Village settings → What's new. Dismiss it with one tap; it never pauses your village.
entries.title: Village notice board

entries.body: Raise a Sawmill and a Mill to turn timber into lumber and grain into flour, then bake bread for your stores. Order work at Sawmill and refinery lines, and judge forged gear by its rarity tag.
entries.title: Sawmills, mills & crafting

entries.body: Every villager now has a name, traits, and job experience. Pin crews to the posts that matter, lock manual assignments, and watch them level up on the job.
entries.title: Named villagers & jobs

entries.body: Hold the line with pass-through gates, rampart walls, and archer and ballista towers, each locked behind research. Raiders now probe your walls for breaches.
entries.title: Gates, ramparts & new towers

entries.body: Refinery machinery, richer building states, and polish across the HUD, cards, equipment rows, and menus — on portrait and landscape phones alike.
entries.title: A village with more life
